judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements token usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, safely handling rounds without reported usage and preserving `undefined` when no usage is reported at all. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including adding tests for two tool rounds (three provider calls) and updating both the specs and `CHANGELOG.md`. To make the signature unambiguous as requested by the ticket, the candidate introduces a structurally compatible `AggregatedUsageMetadata` interface in `src/types/ai.ts`, whereas the reference simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. Minor differences from the reference include placing some acceptance tests in a separate test file, keeping the updated spec statement in the 'Measured semantics' section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than moving it up to the main list, and leaving a `.lore/dod.md` artifact.
